summary: AISDLC-859 docs-site bump workflow token: reuse secrets.AI_SDLC_PAT for ai-sdlc-io writes

options.description: Use secrets.AI_SDLC_PAT (already used by auto-enable-auto-merge and release)
Operator adds a fine-grained AI_SDLC_IO_PAT scoped to ai-sdlc-io

body: The docs-site-bump workflow must push a branch and open/arm a PR in ai-sdlc-framework/ai-sdlc-io; GITHUB_TOKEN is repo-scoped so a PAT is required. Operator confirmed 2026-10-14 (AskUserQuestion, planner session) that the existing AI_SDLC_PAT reaches ai-sdlc-io with contents and pull-requests write. Class (c): credential scope only the operator can confirm.
